Priority Mail
2-3 Days1 & Flat Rate Pricing2

Priority Mail® service includes tracking and delivery in 2-3 days1. Check delivery time estimates with the USPS Service Standards Map. Priority Mail Flat Rate® products let you ship packages up to 70 lbs to any state at the same price. Ship from Post Office™ locations or online from your home or business. Prices start at $11.00 at a Post Office. (Ship online with Click-N-Ship® and get lower Commercial Rates. Businesses can get additional savings by opting in to the Business Rate Card .)
